_about: Fictional reply corpus for the rule-first classifier (app/replies.py + the erasure override in app/inbound.py). Names, companies, domains (*.example) and numbers (90000 1xxxx) are made up. {{name}} placeholders are expanded from 'blocks' by the test loader. 'expected' is the label a careful human would give.
